mark_breakdown.desc: Using the formula mean = sum(xf) / sum(f)

ai_explanation.concept_rule: For a frequency distribution, the mean is the sum of products of values and frequencies divided by total frequency.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Dividing by the number of rows (7) rather than the sum of frequencies (32).

subparts.final_answer: $Refer to column graph of touchdowns vs frequency$

mark_breakdown.desc: Plot axes with touchdowns on horizontal axis and frequency on vertical axis
Correct heights for bars representing touchdown frequencies

subparts.solution: Draw a vertical column graph with touchdowns scored on the horizontal axis ($0$ to $6$) and frequency on the vertical axis ($0$ to $10$). Bars correspond to the given frequencies.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: A column graph displays discrete data where the height of each column represents the frequency of the category.
step_by_step: Label the horizontal axis 'touchdowns' and vertical axis 'frequency'.
Draw columns of equal width for each touchdown value from 0 to 6 with heights equal to their respective frequencies.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Forgetting to label axes or drawing joined histogram bars instead of separated columns for discrete data.
